# Motion graphics: one shape, four beats

A 12 second Magnifito promo built from the four spring-based motion recipes: kinetic type, a card morph, a bar chart and a logo reveal. One brand-coloured shape carries the eye from clip to clip, with real sub-frame motion blur.

- Type: Motion graphics
- Skill: `magnifito-promo`
- Engine: `motion`
- Output: 1920x1080, 12 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4`](../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Make a 12 second 16:9 motion-graphics promo for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency (websites, social media, email, ads, automation). Use the motion engine and all four motion recipes: open on the problem in kinetic type ("Great businesses stay invisible online"), then a service card titled "Grow with Magnifito" with four rows, then a bar chart of monthly leads before and after working with us, then close on our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) with the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value." The chart numbers are illustrative: put them in claims.json and label the chart as illustrative. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- 06-motion-graphics
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/06-motion-graphics/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
mgvideo render . --format 16:9 --force
```

The finished file is `runs/*/final_output_*.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
